title: YUE2 // GROOVE
description: YUE2 // GROOVE is the latest music studio built on the open-source Yue2 model and its inference stack. Generate high-quality full songs from style and lyrics with an editable score plan — powered by the latest YuE model — cover from audio with SheetSage2 and MERT2, refine and compare edits, and keep your works in a reusable, easy-to-manage library. You get high-quality creation with real creative control.
